messages:
reno (NexaSupply): quick heads-up: container CN-7742 arrived at SFO with PO# 10014. during inbound QA our ops found 22/64 RTX 6000 cards failed POST. customs has an advisory on the shipment due to doc mismatch, holding the pallet. creating RMA now.

lina (Fleet Ops): ouch. which racks were allocated for these? we had a rollback window this week and reserved 18 for ap-south-1.

diego (Infra PM): we planned the ap-south rollout for Thu, needs 12 healthy cards. we can do a partial use but perf will be impacted. what's vendor proposing?

reno (NexaSupply): summary from our side:
- Shipped: 64x RTX6000 (PO 10014)
- QA failures: 22 flagged (power rail/POST)
- Cleared by customs: 42 units released
- Hold reason: invoice HS code mismatch + weight discrepancy on manifest; vendor doc fix in flight
- Replacement options: standard RMA 12-18 business days from upstream, expedited cross-dock 4-6 business days (premium), or we can issue a 45% immediate credit if Redwood retains DOA units for forensic return.

tara (Logistics): customs will need corrected commercial invoice + cargo weight reconciliation + supplier signature. if we get corrected docs by EOD PST i can request release within 8-12 hours. otherwise hold extends.

owen (Purchasing): @reno send corrected invoice and signing now. also need serial lists for discrepant units so we can mark them in inventory.

reno (NexaSupply): attaching serial ranges now in thread (manifest excerpt):
```
Affected SNs: RTX6K-300201 -> RTX6K-300222
Released SNs: RTX6K-300223 -> RTX6K-300286
RMA ID: NX-RMA-10014-A
```

lina (Fleet Ops): options for us:
- Option 1: Accept the 42 released units, pull 12 for ap-south rollout, delay remaining capacity and wait for standard RMA (risk: 12-18d).
- Option 2: Push vendor for expedite (4-6d) and pay premium OR accept 45% credit and expedite freight waiver.
- Option 3: Pull from spare pool (cross-region move) with 72h transit + import docs.

diego (Infra PM): tradeoffs: cost vs. time. For product SLAs, missing rollout costs ~ $6k/day. Spare pool transit + customs ~ $3k ops. Vendor expedite premium is quoted where?

reno (NexaSupply): premium expedite add = 7% of unit cost + air freight estimate $1.8k per carton. Waiver path: if Redwood agrees to 45% credit on DOA units and signs the amendment we can waive air freight and prioritize your replacements to 4-6 days.

mona (Finance): rough numbers: expedite premium (7%) + air freight ≈ $26k total. Waiver + 45% credit nets approx $18k benefit vs. standard RMA wait (but we lose asset value on returned DOA). If avoid revenue loss (~$30k by hitting rollout), the waiver path is likely better.

owen (Purchasing): @mona can you ok the waiver path contingent on vendor signing a credit memo and providing serial-level DOA confirmation? we'll need legal cc on amendment.

rma-bot: RMA NX-RMA-10014-A created. tracking: RMA-10014-A-TRK

reno (NexaSupply): I can generate the signed credit memo and updated invoice once you confirm. note: we require the DOA units retained for vendor analysis for 14 days; return shipping to be arranged after analysis.

lina (Fleet Ops): I'll prepare a short-term mitigation: allocate 12 released units for ap-south, schedule 6 more from spare pool if replacements slip. pinging @diego for fallback plan.

diego (Infra PM): fallback acknowledged. If expedited replacements land within 5 business days we flip to them, otherwise proceed with spare pool pickup. document the change window in the rollout ticket.

owen (Purchasing): OK approve vendor waiver path pending: (1) signed credit memo attached to PO amendment, (2) serial list for DOA, (3) vendor confirmation of 4-6 day prioritized fill. Reno, please attach now.

reno (NexaSupply): attaching signed amendment and corrected invoice. also confirmed prioritized fill to secondary fulfillment center with ETA 4-6 biz days.

tara (Logistics): got docs. submitting to customs now. estimated release time after acceptance: ~10 hours. scheduling carrier on standby for same-day pickup.

mona (Finance): approving cost-neutral waiver based on projected revenue avoidance. Finance to record 45% credit line item against PO. please route to accounting for reconciliations.

lina (Fleet Ops): marking ap-south rollout green. spare-pool hold released unless we need it after 72h. thanks.

diego (Infra PM): once replacements arrive, tag them with temporary test fleet label and run burn-in for 48h before production image. include root-cause notes from vendor in ticket.

rma-bot: RMA NX-RMA-10014-A status updated to "in-transit replacements". tracking: RMA-10014-A-TRK

owen (Purchasing): closing loop: amendment signed, credit memo attached to PO 10014. thanks all :thumbsup:

lina (Fleet Ops): postmortem to follow on vendor SLA and spare thresholds. putting a 20% safety buffer on next order.

reno (NexaSupply): apologies for the disruption. we'll follow up with root-cause and return instructions for DOA units once replacements are delivered.
